title: Luuna ticket projection
description: A ticket is the unit of intent a plan revision binds to. Legacy projects use the explicitly temporary SQLite source; component-enabled projects use a revision-aware projection of the authoritative Missions record.

purpose.description: Absent means feature. A testing_setup ticket is the prerequisite workflow a repository without a usable testing setup is offered (ADR 0022).

type.description: The Missions issue type. Absent means task (ADR 0058).

priority.description: The Missions priority, 0 (critical) to 4 (backlog). Absent means 2.

labels.description: Lowercase labels, as Missions stores them; never Luuna's own luuna-ticket- delivery marker. Absent means none.
